description: This file defines the 'UnivariateFunction' interface in the Apache Commons Math library, representing a univariate real function. It includes documentation and an example illustrating how users can implement the interface and handle exceptions during function evaluation.

classes.name: UnivariateFunction
classes.description: An interface representing a univariate real-valued function with a single method 'value' that computes the function's value at a given point.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Computes the value of the function at a specified point x.
